summary: Gorax provides a comprehensive spending guide for Dragonheir: Silent Gods, detailing how players can maximize value for their money. He highlights using content creator support codes in the Treasure Market and third-party top-up options on BuffBuff for extra discounts and bonus events. High-value recommendations include Traveler's Departure Gifts, seasonal game passes, monthly passes, daily stamina offers, seasonal double Dragon Crystal top-ups, and packs containing Master Scrolls in the Departure Supply and Rift Vault.

heroes.name: Sintrellia
heroes.note: Obtainable via the Departure Boost Pack alongside dice and Master Scrolls.

tips: Enter creator support code Gorax1 in the Treasure Market under Support Content Creator to unlock gifts and monthly discounted packs.
Prioritize game passes, monthly passes, and daily stamina packs for the best long-term progression resources.
Take advantage of the once-per-season double Dragon Crystal top-up offer.
Prioritize packs that include Master Scrolls, as hero skill scrolls are the main bottleneck for leveling up skills.
Wait to use guaranteed Legendary Hero Selection Chests until after summoning on featured banners to avoid pulling duplicates.
title: STOP Wasting Money! What You SHOULD Buy in Dragonheir | Dragonheir x Dragonstride
